title: 校园场景词汇
goal: 理解校园场景词汇，并根据相关词语确定交谈事项。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

points.label: 认识校园场景的常用词
根据词汇判断对话的场景和事项

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：Updated TOEFL iBT Test Overview
sources.used: 各题型的说明、考查的能力、官方样题

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

body.p: 校园词汇要结合动作和对象来判断。withdraw from a course 是退课，withdraw a request 是撤回申请。听到 withdraw，还要听后面的对象。
场景由一组相关的词共同确定。renew、due date 和 borrower 常与图书借阅有关；renew 和 housing contract 则指住宿合同续期。具体手续以对话内容为准。

cards.title: 词汇表：选课与注册
rows: Students enroll in the workshop online.
Statistics is a prerequisite for this course.
I'm taking an art elective this term.
I'm on the waitlist for the seminar.
She decided to withdraw from the course.
My advisor helped me compare the courses.
同一课程的不同教学班
The afternoon section still has space.
cards.note: credit 在这里指学分，three credits 是三个学分。退款时说的 store credit 是可用余额，意思不同。

cards.title: 词汇表：图书馆
rows: The catalog lists both print and electronic books.
Return the recording to the circulation desk.
The loan lasts for two weeks.
Can I renew this book online?
Place a hold on the book that is checked out.
The reference book must stay in the reading room.
Request the book through interlibrary loan.
The archive keeps letters from former students.
cards.note: hold 是预约，renew 是延长已有的借阅。对已借出的书 place a hold，是排队等这本书还回来。

cards.title: 词汇表：宿舍与餐厅
rows: The residence hall has a shared kitchen.
My roommate and I share a desk lamp.
The resident assistant explains the quiet hours.
Read the housing contract before signing.
The meal plan includes weekday lunches.
The dining hall serves breakfast early.
Please tell the cook about any dietary restrictions.
One serving of soup is included.
cards.note: maintenance 也包括定期维护。routine maintenance 是例行保养，设备不一定坏了。

cards.title: 词汇表：费用与手续
rows: Tuition does not include housing in this example.
特定服务或项目的费用
The equipment deposit is returned after inspection.
The refund will go to the original payment card.
Keep the receipt as proof of payment.
The financial aid office reviews funding requests.
The scholarship covers part of the tuition.
Apply for a waiver of the application fee.
The application requires an official transcript.
The form needs the supervisor’s signature.
cards.note: waiver 是免除，refund 是退还已付的钱。拿到 fee waiver 的人一开始就不用付这笔费用。

cards.title: 词汇表：课程与作业
rows: The syllabus lists the weekly topics.
The assignment asks for two examples.
The deadline for the essay is Friday.
The first draft needs a clearer introduction.
The feedback explains which argument needs evidence.
Add a citation for the quoted sentence.
Presenting another writer’s work as one’s own is plagiarism.
The professor holds office hours on Tuesdays.
The rubric describes the criteria for the report.
cards.note: extension 只改变期限，作业内容不变。an extension until Monday 是获准在周一前交。

body.box:
Student: My draft is ready. Should I upload it as the final assignment?
Tutor: Bring it to office hours first. We'll compare it with the rubric and discuss the feedback.
Student: So I still have time to revise it?
Tutor: Yes. The deadline is next week.

What is the student arranging?
1. Submission of an assignment without revision
2. A discussion of unfinished work before submission
3. An extension beyond the stated deadline
4. A change to the criteria used in the rubric

body.p: draft、office hours、rubric 和 feedback 都指向提交前的作业辅导，第二项正确。deadline is next week 说明还有时间修改，并没有延期。
第一项漏掉了 Bring it to office hours first。第三项把还有修改时间说成了获准延期。第四项把对照评分标准说成了修改评分标准。

groups.text: The course is full. Lina joined the waitlist instead of registering for another section.

options: A list of students already guaranteed seats
A list of students waiting for available places
A list of sections that have been canceled
A list of courses Lina has completed
items.why: 依据是 The course is full 和 joined the waitlist。课已满，Lina 在等空出的名额，即第二项。

groups.text: The atlas was due yesterday. The librarian says it is now overdue and asks for its return.

options: Available for a new borrower
Reserved before its arrival
Not returned by the required time
Returned earlier than expected
items.why: 依据是 was due yesterday 和 now overdue。书过了归还期限还没还，即第三项。

groups.text: The residence hall has a leaking tap. A maintenance worker will inspect it this afternoon.

options: Checking a tap that needs repair this afternoon
Replacing the leaking tap before it is inspected
Inspecting a tap that has already been fixed
Delaying the inspection until tomorrow afternoon
items.why: 依据是 a leaking tap 和 A maintenance worker will inspect it this afternoon。今天下午检查待修的水龙头，即第一项。

groups.text: The cafeteria label lists milk as an allergen, so a student with a milk allergy chooses another dish.

options: An ingredient absent from every dish
A portion of food served without milk
A dish prepared specifically for allergies
A substance that can trigger an allergic reaction
items.why: 依据是 milk as an allergen 和 a milk allergy。allergen 是会引起过敏的物质，即第四项。

groups.text: The instructor approved an extension, so the report is due next Monday rather than this Friday.

options: The report’s topic
The amount of time allowed
The number of reports required
The instructor’s grading criteria
items.why: 依据是 due next Monday rather than this Friday。延期改变的是交报告的时间，即第二项。

groups.text: The scholarship pays part of Amir's tuition. He must arrange housing payments separately.

options: The cost of housing covered by the scholarship
The payment for housing arranged separately
The charge for receiving instruction
The entire scholarship paid to Amir
items.why: 依据是 The scholarship pays part of Amir's tuition。tuition 是上课的费用，即学费，第三项；住宿费另付。

lines.text: The meal plan includes lunch, but I have a dietary restriction.
Please tell the dining hall staff before they serve you. They can explain which dishes contain the ingredient you avoid.
Can I ask for a smaller serving as well?
Yes, just mention that when you choose your dish.

options: Adapting a campus meal to a student’s needs
Adding more lunches to an existing meal plan
Teaching staff to prepare all dishes without one ingredient
Canceling a meal plan because portions are too small
items.why: 依据是 meal plan、dietary restriction 和 Please tell the dining hall staff。学生请餐厅按自己的饮食需要安排，即第一项。

items.stem: What does the student also request?
options: A larger meal-plan allowance
A lunch added to the meal plan
A reduced portion of food
An extension of lunch hours
items.why: 依据是 Can I ask for a smaller serving as well?。smaller serving 是少一些的份量，即第三项。

lines.text: I paid the equipment deposit for the ceramics course. How do I get it back?
Return the tools with your receipt. We'll inspect them and then process the refund.
Do I need the instructor's signature?
Not for this return. The receipt is enough.

items.stem: What is the main matter being handled?
options: Paying a new deposit for replacement tools
Recovering a payment made as security for tools
Buying the tools used in a ceramics course
Requesting an exemption from an unpaid deposit
items.why: 依据是 paid the equipment deposit 和 process the refund。还了工具就退回押金，即第二项；押金已经付过，不是申请免付。

items.stem: What document does the employee require?
options: An inspection report signed by the student
A form signed by the course instructor
A statement showing that the tools were purchased
Proof that the original payment was made
items.why: 依据是 Return the tools with your receipt 和 The receipt is enough。收据就是付款证明，即第四项；教师签名不需要。

lines.text: My course assignment uses a quotation from a journal. Is a citation enough?
Use quotation marks as well, and make clear which words come from the source.
I don't want it to look like my own writing.
Exactly. Clear attribution helps avoid plagiarism.

options: Marking which words in an assignment are borrowed
Obtaining permission to change a journal quotation
Removing all quotations from an assignment
Replacing a source citation with original writing
items.why: 依据是 make clear which words come from the source。讨论的是在作业里标明引用的文字，即第一项。

items.stem: What does the student want to avoid?
options: Adding a citation to a quotation from a journal
Using quotation marks around borrowed words
Presenting another writer’s words as original work
Identifying the source of a quoted sentence
items.why: 依据是 I don't want it to look like my own writing。学生不想让别人的话看起来像自己写的，即第三项。

groups.text: Biology is a prerequisite for the field course; students must complete it before enrolling.

options: A required earlier course or qualification
An optional course taken afterward
A course completed at the same time
A replacement for the field course
items.why: 依据是 students must complete it before enrolling。prerequisite 是选课前必须先满足的要求，即第一项。

groups.text: The requested dictionary is a reference book and must be consulted inside the library.

items.stem: What kind of book is described?
options: A book borrowed for reading at home
A book recording the library’s loans
A book reserved for a future borrower
A work used to look up information
items.why: 依据是 The requested dictionary is a reference book。词典是供查阅的工具书，即第四项。

groups.text: Rosa needs an official transcript showing the courses she has taken and the grades she received.

options: A plan of courses to take in the future
A certified record of academic results
A request to revise grades already received
A guide explaining how courses award grades
items.why: 依据是 showing the courses she has taken and the grades she received。official transcript 是正式的成绩记录，即第二项。

groups.text: The bursar approved a fee waiver, so the student does not have to pay the application charge.

options: An extension of the application payment deadline
A refund of a previously paid application charge
Permission not to pay the specified charge
A receipt proving that the charge was paid
items.why: 依据是 does not have to pay the application charge。fee waiver 是免付这笔申请费，即第三项；第二项的退款要先付过钱。

groups.text: The syllabus lists the course topics, required readings, and dates of assessments.

options: A document outlining the course and its schedule
A record of results from completed assessments
A collection of answers to the required readings
An application to change assessment dates
items.why: 依据是 lists the course topics, required readings, and dates of assessments。syllabus 是介绍课程内容和安排的大纲，即第一项。

groups.text: The rubric awards marks for evidence, organization, and accurate use of sources.

options: The marks one assignment has already received
The order in which sources must be read
The evidence supporting one particular conclusion
The criteria used to assess the work
items.why: 依据是 awards marks for evidence, organization, and accurate use of sources。rubric 列出的是评分标准，即第四项。

lines.text: I'd like to study the old student newsletters for my project.
The archive has them, but they're not ordinary loans. They stay in the reading room.
Can I reserve a time to consult them?
Yes. Tell the archive staff which years you need, and they'll prepare the folders.
So I shouldn't place a regular book hold?
That's right. This is a request to consult archival material, not to borrow a book.

items.stem: What service is the student arranging?
options: Renewal of newsletters already borrowed
Access to historical material kept for consultation
Delivery of archived folders to the student’s home
Placement of an ordinary hold on a newsletter
items.why: 依据是 The archive has them 和 a request to consult archival material。学生要预约在阅览室查阅旧档案，即第二项。

options: Borrowing complete folders from borrowing individual newsletters
Renewing an existing loan from placing a new hold
Consulting records from borrowing a book
Using current newsletters from reading those published earlier
items.why: 依据是 This is a request to consult archival material, not to borrow a book。工作人员区分的是查阅档案和借书，即第三项。

lines.text: I'm choosing my courses with my advisor. Can this statistics elective count toward my major?
It can, but check the prerequisite. Have you completed the introductory mathematics course?
Yes. It's on my transcript.
Then ask your advisor to confirm the credits. Are you adding it or replacing another course?
Understood. I want to add it to my study plan, not drop anything.

items.stem: What matter is the student trying to resolve?
options: Whether a chosen course can satisfy degree requirements
Whether to withdraw from introductory mathematics
Whether prior mathematics credits can replace the statistics course
Whether to remove statistics credits from the study plan
items.why: 依据是 Can this statistics elective count toward my major? 和 confirm the credits。学生想确认这门课能否计入专业要求，即第一项。

options: To request permission to withdraw from statistics
To cancel the introductory course registration
To change grades from the mathematics course
To show completion of an earlier required course
items.why: 依据是 Have you completed the introductory mathematics course? 和 It's on my transcript。成绩单证明先修课已经修完，即第四项。
